parametersEmpty: Add param("name", 0.5, min: 0.0, max: 1.0) to create a live control.
previewHint: This is a bundled preview. Run compiles the code in the editor.
privacy: Your code stays in this tab
shareHint: The link contains your code, not an uploaded file. Opening a link never runs its code automatically. Press Run after reviewing it.
galleryHint: Load an example to explore its preview. Run compiles your changes.
helpTitle: A small language for moving images.
helpIntro: Write real Crystal. A sketch builds a texture graph once; WebGL animates it. Finish each chain with .out. Run or Ctrl/⌘ + Enter compiles locally in a separate Worker.
helpSignals: time, frame, mouse.x and mouse.y are GPU expressions, not ordinary numbers. Use .sin, .cos, .map and arithmetic. param creates a slider. Live expressions cannot control a Crystal if or loop.
helpFeedback: src(o0) through src(o3) read the previous frame. All four outputs update together, so output order does not change timing. Reset clears their memory and resets time.
helpLimit: The current compiler has no garbage collection. Crystal runs once per build and its instance is discarded; animation stays on the GPU. Source, graph size and execution time are bounded. Stop terminates a stuck Worker.
helpShortcuts: Ctrl/⌘ + Enter: Run · Ctrl/⌘ + S: Save · Ctrl/⌘ + /: comment · Tab: indent · Escape: close a dialog.
apiCompatibility: Hydra-inspired, not a drop-in Hydra port. Noise, shape coordinates and modulation differ. Inputs supports local media, cameras and microphone analysis. No JavaScript eval or arbitrary GLSL.
apiTechnical: Function names and technical descriptions below remain in English. Compiler diagnostics are also in English.
changedDuringCompile: Source changed during compilation. Run again to apply the current editor contents.
restored: Restored your local draft. The current view is a preset preview; press Run to compile your code.
loadedShared: Shared code loaded without running it. Review the code, then press Run.
replaceConfirm: Replace the edited code with this example? Save your draft first to keep a separate copy.
sourceTooLarge: Source files must be 64 KiB or smaller.
initialLog:
Preset preview loaded.
Run compiles real Crystal → Wasm → a GPU graph.
The compiler downloads on first use. No code is uploaded.
desc_chromatic-tide: Oscillators, soft distortion and mirrored color.
desc_glass-garden: Animated Voronoi cells become stained glass.
desc_orbital-bloom: A small polygon drifts through a repeated field.
desc_feedback-tunnel: The previous frame becomes the next frame’s canvas.
desc_neon-lattice: A rotating geometric grid with a spectral carrier.
desc_mouse-mirror: Move the pointer to change frequency and distortion.
desc_two-signals: Two output buffers, connected through a delayed signal.
desc_ink-contours: Quantized noise draws a moving topographic map.
desc_molten-prism: Cellular texture with slowly shifting color.
desc_breathing-rings: A live sine expression controls expanding rings.
desc_crystal-petals: Real Crystal methods and loops generate a texture.
desc_afterimage: A simple rectangle paints fading blue trails.
lastGoodView: The image shows the last successful compilation. Run to apply the edited code.
inputsHint: Load a local image or video, or enable a camera. Choose a slot and use src(s0) in your code. Files and device access stay in this tab.
audioHint: audio.fft(0…31): 32 logarithmic bands, low to high. audio.level: RMS volume. Both return 0…1 and are zero while the microphone is off. Sound is not sent to speakers.
devicesHint: Camera and microphone start only after you enable them. Stop releases devices. Reloading or opening a shared link never enables them automatically. HTTPS or localhost is required.
